source: Recorded 2026-10-10 from claude-agent-acp 0.85.1 by a direct ACP client advertising AIR v1 sessionFailure, asyncTasks and nativeSubagentSessions. claudeNativeTurn: two parallel subagents, one launching a nested subagent, a permission request from a subagent (answered allow once), and a steer injected while they ran. claudeNativeCancelled: one subagent, then session/cancel on the parent. claudeNativeReplay: session/load of the same session in a new adapter process. Paths are rewritten to /work/repo, /tmp/claude and /Users/me, the local user name to me, the machine's hostname to host.local wherever it appears (in streamed text too, where it spans chunks), quota metadata is removed, the product's former name is rewritten to Ottam (2026-11-07), in recorded text too, and auth status and available-command frames are left out; nothing else is edited. Follow-ups, recorded 2026-10-10 from the same adapter in another session: claudeNativeFirstRun runs one subagent; claudeNativeResumed is the next turn, where the parent messages that finished subagent; claudeNativeRunningFollowUp launches another and messages it while it runs. In each turn the parent's first frame is moved to the front; nothing else is reordered. claudeNativeHandback is rebuilt, not recorded: claudeNativeFirstRun with a SubagentHandback call from the subagent inserted before it ends, shaped like a stored SubagentHandback row from a 2026-10-11 run, with the report shortened.
